content: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Apps (2025) elevates Sensitive Information Disclosure (LLM02) and Prompt Injection (LLM01): secrets/PII in prompts or context can leak via model outputs or vendor training; system-prompt 'do not reveal' is not a hard control. Mitigation: sanitize/redact before paste, separate secrets from prompts, treat model output as untrusted, never rely on prompt text alone for confidentiality.
